name: services/housing/resident_type
description:
Get information on a single resident type.

Dormitory residents can be divided into several types, such as students, employees, or guests. A complete list of all valid resident types currently defined in this USOS installation can be retrieved with the resident_type_index method.
brief_description: Get information on a single resident type

arguments.name: resident_type_id
arguments.description: ID of the type of resident

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • id - ID of this type;

  • name - LangDict with a short name.
